exercises.instructions: Change the following active sentences into passive voice. Choose the correct passive form.

questions.question: Doctors treat patients. → Patients ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present passive: Object + am/is/are + past participle + by subject. Simple Present passive: Object + am/is/are + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: Parents bring up children. → Children ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present passive: Object + are + past participle + by subject. Simple Present passive: Object + are + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: We love our country. → Our country ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present passive: Object + is + past participle + by subject. Simple Present passive: Object + is + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: Masons build houses. → Houses ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present passive: Object + are + past participle + by subject. Simple Present passive: Object + are + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: Carpenters make furniture. → Furniture ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present passive: Object + is + past participle + by subject. Simple Present passive: Object + is + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: Mother made a cake yesterday. → A cake ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Past passive: Object + was/were + past participle + by subject. Simple Past passive: Object + was/were + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: The boy teased the girl. → The girl ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Past passive: Object + was + past participle + by subject. Simple Past passive: Object + was + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: My friend bought a new car. → A new car ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Past passive: Object + was + past participle + by subject. Simple Past passive: Object + was + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: Sue changed the flat tire. → The flat tire ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Past passive: Object + was + past participle + by subject. Simple Past passive: Object + was + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: I will clean the house every Saturday. → The house ___.
options: will be cleaned by me every Saturday
will cleaned by me every Saturday
is cleaned by me every Saturday
questions.answer: will be cleaned by me every Saturday
questions.explanation: Simple Future passive: Object + will + be + past participle + by subject. Simple Future passive: Object + will + be + past participle + by subject။

questions.question: I will write a letter. → A letter ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Future passive: Object + will + be + past participle. Simple Future passive: Object + will + be + past participle။

questions.question: She will not help us. → We ___.
options: will not be helped by her
questions.answer: will not be helped by her
questions.explanation: Simple Future passive negative: Object + will + not + be + past participle. Simple Future passive negative: Object + will + not + be + past participle။

questions.question: She is reading the newspaper now. → The newspaper ___.

was being read by her now
questions.answer: is being read by her now
questions.explanation: Present Continuous passive: Object + am/is/are + being + past participle. Present Continuous passive: Object + am/is/are + being + past participle။
